title: Legendary Gem Tier List Rank *0 → *5
subject: Which legendaries gain the most from gems — Elite Leagues, Elite legendary fights and the Underground

board.title: Legendary Gem Tier List Rank *0 — *5 — all Lv 100

method.summary: Rank 5 doubles a Pokémon's stats (×1.15 per rank, ×2.01 at 5). This list shows who gains the most: each legendary ranked to *5 alone and dropped into the best *0 team. White Kyurem is still #1 overall, but no longer everywhere: Dialga now leads the Elite Leagues and Ho-Oh the Elite legendary fights. Since v0.5.03, Ho-Oh (60 → 80), Entei (33 → 63), Dialga, Reshiram and Kyogre climbed the most. Gems are type-locked: a legendary only ranks up with gems of the types tagged under it, and each Arceus plate is a separate Pokémon with its own gem type. Simulated with the game's own battle engine on build d8622a1fb3. Box: all 79 gemmable legendaries and forms plus strong non-legendaries, all Lv 100, Rank 0, not shiny. For each fight the best Rank-0 team was searched, then each legendary was set to Rank 5, ranked in place or swapped into its best slot, and replayed on the same seeds. Elite: 45 legendary Elite fights + 5 Elite Leagues × 2 tiers, each at the first tier a Rank-0 team wins under half the time (48 tries per fight, 24 per League; win rate + 0.2 × damage dealt). Underground: best Rank-0 trio per theme, 6 themes × 16 expeditions, gain in floors reached. Bars are scaled to the best legendary in each area; the tier is the average of the three. Changes since v0.5.03 that matter: signature moves (v0.5.08) help Ho-Oh and Entei most; draining moves no longer heal (v0.5.141); status lands ≤75% and sleep/freeze/paralysis stack resistance (v0.5.13); boss fights got small tweaks (v0.5.142).

algorithm.goal: Rank every gemmable legendary by how much going from Rank 0 to Rank 5 improves Elite Leagues, Elite legendary fights and the Underground.
algorithm.engine: The game's own battle engine at build d8622a1fb3
steps: Build the box: all 79 gemmable legendaries and forms plus strong non-legendaries, Lv 100, Rank 0, not shiny.
For each fight, search the best Rank-0 team.
Set each legendary to Rank 5, rank it in place or swap it into its best slot, and replay the same seeds.
Elite: 45 legendary Elite fights + 5 Elite Leagues × 2 tiers, each at the first tier a Rank-0 team wins under half the time; 48 tries per fight, 24 per League; score = win rate + 0.2 × damage dealt.
Underground: best Rank-0 trio per theme, 6 themes × 16 expeditions; score = gain in floors reached.
Scale each area's bars to the best legendary in that area; the tier is the average of the three.
Read each member's three bars off the board in pixels with tools/barmeasure.py; 76px is the full track, the best in that area.

parameters.box: 79 gemmable legendaries and forms + strong non-legendaries

acceptance.eliteTier: A Rank-0 team must win under half the time at the chosen tier.
acceptance.score: Elite score = win rate + 0.2 × damage dealt; the Underground score is floors gained.
acceptance.sameSeeds: Rank-0 and Rank-5 runs use the same seeds.

measurement.helper: python3 tools/barmeasure.py boards/legendary-rank-tiers-2.png prints every bar band and its run lengths
measurement.algorithm: Each card prints three bars under LG (Elite Leagues), EL (Elite legendary fights), UG (Underground), coloured 255,203,61 / 201,168,255 / 91,224,160. A bar is a solid horizontal run about 6 rows tall (4 for the smallest); its length is the union of that colour over the band's rows, from the card's left edge. Read the runs left to right against the names printed above the row.
measurement.scale: 76px is the full track: the best legendary's bar reaches it in every area, so px / 76 is the area ratio the board draws.
measurement.units: areas.<area>.px is the bar length in board pixels.

gameFacts: Rank 5 multiplies stats by ×2.01; each rank gives ×1.15.
Gems are type-locked: a legendary only ranks up with gems of its own types.
Each Arceus plate is a separate Pokémon with its own gem type.
Signature moves (v0.5.08) count as the strongest move of their type; Ho-Oh and Entei gain the most.
Status moves land 75% at most; sleep, freeze and paralysis stack resistance on both sides (v0.5.13).
Boss fights had small adjustments in v0.5.142.

uncertain: `areas` holds each bar's length in board pixels (76px = the best in that area). The board prints no absolute score, and the rounded bar ends put each length within 1px. The stored order is the board order.
The vertical tier grouping (which row belongs to which letter tier) is not legible; all members are stored in one 'board order' group.
The OCR also read 'Arceus Flying?' with a question mark; the sprite chip follows the Flying plate row, so it is stored as Arceus Flying.
Two best-sink names are ambiguous between a base and a form (Landorus vs Landorus Therian, Genesect vs Genesect Burn); both appear in the OCR rows and both are stored as separate entries.
